ms.report:
Evidence of milestone completion
1. Public repository link
https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet
The GeroWallet browser extension repository is public and visible to the community. It contains the complete extension: the background service worker, key derivation and encrypted storage, the transaction signing path, transaction building for staking, governance and dApp flows, multi-chain support across Cardano, Bitcoin, Midnight and Apex Fusion, and the full user interface.
The repository is licensed under the Apache License 2.0, an OSI-approved permissive open-source licence. The full licence text is at the repository root, alongside a NOTICE file, and GitHub reports the repository licence as Apache-2.0.
・Licence: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/blob/development/LICENSE
・Notice: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/blob/development/NOTICE

2. Documentation accessible in the repository and on the website
On the website: https://gerowallet.io/docs
The Developer Documentation section of the GeroWallet site covers:
・Building from source: prerequisites, cloning, installing dependencies, environment configuration, and loading the unpacked extension in a browser
・Configuration, including which environment variables are required and which integrations need your own keys
・Repository structure, mapping each top-level source directory to its contents
・Contributing: the fork and pull request workflow, coding standards, commit conventions, and the Code of Conduct
・Security: the vulnerability disclosure process
・Licensing: the Apache 2.0 terms and what they permit, linked to the full text

In the repository:
・README, overview and quick start: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/blob/development/README.md
・Architecture and system design: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/blob/development/ARCHITECTURE.md
・Contribution guidelines: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/blob/development/CONTRIBUTING.md
・Code of Conduct: https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/b
